en: A monochrome postcard showing an inner Renaissance courtyard with arcaded galleries on several levels, a staircase leading up to the first gallery, and ornate dormer windows on the roof. In the courtyard stands a decorative well with an elaborate wrought‑iron cover. Handwritten notes appear at the top and bottom. Printed in red at the upper center is the caption identifying the scene.
